frames.title: Four hours' sleep. The dog is at the door.
Doesn't care about your training plan.
How much usable energy is here?
Round the block. Home when they turn back.
Garden today. Someone else does the walk.

slides.title: Working from home after a broken night?
slides.body: Movement can fit around the laptop. It doesn't have to fight it.

slides.title: Run the check, not the inbox
slides.body: Two minutes. Night, fatigue, willingness to move. Separately.

slides.title: Keep the lunch session, shorter
slides.body: Same plan, smaller. Decide the size now.

slides.title: Ten minutes outside before the first call
slides.body: Gentle movement, with a clear stop: the call.

slides.title: Rest, decided at 8am
slides.body: Not drifted into at 3pm with guilt attached.

slides.title: Write it in the calendar
slides.body: A decision you can see is easier to keep.
